entities.summary: A hip roof, hip-roof or hipped roof, is a type of roof where all sides slope downward to the walls — thus, a hipped roof has no gables or other vertical sides to the roof. Variants of hipped roofs include the Simple Hip Roof, Pyramid Hip Roof, Cross Hip Roof, and Half Hip Roof. Other variations include the Dutch Gable Roof, the Mansard Roof, and the Hip-and-Valley Roof.
